title: The superdeterminism is not fine tuned or conspiratorial

statements.text: Measured by its natural $p$-adic state-space metric, the discretized framework is not fine tuned and hence not conspiratorial. Superdeterminism is not invoked by fiat but emerges from number-theoretic constraints.
